scope: Local partner PMS and SynXis integration authorization behavior and UI error-state checks. No hosted data or production configuration changed.
change: Owner/admin access is resolved to an explicitly owned partner; delegated integration roles are validated through the existing database resolver. Unsupported roles and absent access stay denied. PMS connection load failures no longer appear as an empty property list.

focusedTests.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/partner-integration-access.test.ts tests/partner-pms-connections.test.ts tests/partner-synxis-onboarding.test.ts

limits: Authorization tests exercise the resolver with mocked Supabase RPC responses and do not prove hosted policy or account-role configuration.
The live partner integration page still requires a deployment of this fix before browser acceptance can be confirmed.
Vendor credentials, property mappings, external PMS connectivity, and live reservation synchronization remain unverified.
